message:
The build directory seems to be empty or the build was cleaned. Let me check what's in the build directory and find the config header.

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<parameter=command>bash /workspace/build.sh 'ls /tmp/build_asan/ 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; find /tmp/build_asan -type f 2>/dev/null | head -30; echo "---"; find /gt/_work/src -name "OpenEXRConfig*" -o -name "IlmThreadConfig*" -o -name "ImathConfig*" 2>/dev/null | head -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
